title: Salvatore Pais inertial mass reduction patent

tellings.quote: In 2016, the Navy filed a patent under inventor Salvatore Pais for what they called craft using an inertial mass reduction device.

plain: In 2016 the US Navy filed a patent naming the inventor Salvatore Pais for a 'craft using an inertial mass reduction device', meaning a vehicle that would make itself resist motion less so it could move in ways ordinary aircraft cannot. Michels tells this himself, citing the patent by its own title. He brings it up because it suggests the Navy was formally pursuing technology like what UFOs are said to do.
